messages:
tess_sales: Quick sync 90-day renewal for NovaCorp. They want to swap standard 20% uplift for a smaller retainer + usage commit. Can pricing give a short example we can share?

omar_pricing: We can. Two quick sketches: (A) $60k/mo retainer covering baseline + 25% discounted overage, (B) refundable $80k retainer credited over Q1 and Q2 + 12-month commit at 12% off list. Need current run-rate to pick.

lee_se: POC still running, they asked to apply current POC credits to first invoice. Security flagged BYOK question. We can run sandbox on Redwood-managed keys for now.

nina_csm: Customer wants price protection clause in case model infra costs drop and a soft opt-out at month 9. Also wants a clear POC credit line on the SOW.

omar_pricing: If run-rate ~ $900k/yr, option B yields committed ARR ~ $792k after discounts; refundable retainer just reduces cash flow pressure. Deal Desk will accept POC credits if <4% of ARR and listed in SOW.

sec-bot: Security note: temporary sandbox with Redwood keys approved. BYOK requires addendum; target 45 days post-sign.

tess_sales: Perfect. Next: Omar to upload one-pager into DD-7488, Nina to get sandbox acknowledgement signed, Lee to confirm POC credit amount. I'll draft the customer email after numbers are in. :thumbsup:
